beats.name: Setup
beats.summary: A night nurse describes the 3:12 ping from her doorbell camera and the still figure on her porch.

beats.name: Escalation
beats.summary: She dismisses it as a prank until she looks closely at the date stamp on the recordings.

beats.name: Turn
beats.summary: The date says tomorrow; the recordings are arriving from the future.

beats.name: Payoff
beats.summary: She waits on the porch and the new recording shows her from behind, then her own door opening.

beats.name: Loop
beats.summary: Something steps out of the empty house, and the camera pings again.

ending_line_idea: End on the doorbell camera pinging again, echoing the opening line.
